payload.core_mechanism_summary: 0/1 knapsack DP with 1D state f[j] representing min cost to cover j items. Each item i has weight t_i+1 and cost c_i; items processed with reverse loop to avoid reuse.
payload.rationale: The solution exactly formulates a knapsack problem: select a subset of items to pay such that the sum of (t_i+1) >= n, minimizing total cost. The 1D DP array and reverse iteration are classic knapsack optimization.
